_comment: Crew needs and health rules. All numbers are placeholders for game balance, NOT real NASA data.

base_power_per_sol.note: Heaters, air fans and computers. Always powered first.

radiation_limit.note: Game exposure limit in made-up 'dose points', not millisieverts.

stress_per_sol.note: Isolation and hard work. Habitats cancel it out.

cold_penalty.note: Lost when base power cannot be met.

crowding_penalty.note: Lost per crew member without a habitat bed.

radiation_sickness_threshold.note: Daily dose above this hurts health.

low_supply_threshold.note: Fraction of storage. Below this the crew rations and worries.

oxygen.fail: Oxygen ran out, so the crew had to evacuate.
oxygen.tip: Electrolyzers make oxygen but need power AND water. Keep them running with 'Life support first', and build an Ice miner to feed them.

water.fail: Water ran out, so the crew had to evacuate.
water.tip: Ice miners make water. Greenhouses and electrolyzers both drink it, so add a miner before you add more of them.

food.fail: Food ran out, so the crew had to evacuate.
food.tip: Greenhouses need lots of power and water. Build power first, then greenhouses, and add batteries for storms and nights.

health.fail: The crew became too sick and unhappy to keep working, so they had to evacuate.
health.tip: Habitats keep the crew happy. Keep the heaters powered, don't let supplies run low, and shelter from solar storms.

radiation.fail: The crew reached the radiation limit and had to go home early.
radiation.tip: Build a storm shelter as soon as a solar particle event is announced, and add regolith shielding early, because it takes time to build.
